containment_review.assignment: A fresh unnamed JobObject is created. Only OpenProcess(process.pid), where process is the fresh Popen child, is passed to AssignProcessToJobObject. No process enumeration, existing-PID assignment, parent assignment, taskkill or service control exists in these wrappers.
containment_review.cleanup: KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE is set. Finally closes this JobObject; process.kill() applies only to that same Popen child if still running. Child returned zero and timeout=false.
containment_review.reasoning: All seven missing processes existed in before snapshot, before the fresh validation child launched. They cannot have been born as descendants of this later child. The reviewed code never assigns them or their parents to its job. Direct targeting by this code is not supported; no historical OS job audit was collected to independently prove membership.

conclusions.mcp_restart_hypothesis: Possible but unproven. Missing paths identify cua_node, Blender MCP and generic uv Python. Other same-path processes under Codex parent 38128 appear in both snapshots; zero newly observed same-parent processes were found at postcheck. No restart event, exit log, or chat ownership was captured; saved snapshots do not demonstrate a restart.
conclusions.nikke_service_preservation: not verifiable from captured baseline; retain original false flag, do not upgrade strict audit
conclusions.actions: No process/service restart or stop, no reconnect, no GPU retry, no build, no original receipt modification.
